checks: Selecting an in-flight JPEG prefetch reuses one un-aborted HTTP request; loading edits stay blocked and displayed pixels match the target frame.
A selected in-flight prefetch returning 429 retries once at foreground priority and displays the correct frame.
Rapid navigation away from a promoted slow prefetch cancels it; a late old response cannot replace the final requested frame.
After visiting 21 actual 1080p JPEGs, the original decoded image is released; revisiting decodes its retained compressed JPEG without HTTP and preserves every decoded pixel.
Leaving a workspace aborts requests and releases decoded URLs; returning fetches again rather than reusing old compressed data, and logout releases the new workspace.

measurements.label: selected busy prefetch gets foreground retry

environment.purpose: correctness regression, not a performance benchmark
